questions.q: To clearly define the relationship and avoid chaos between tiers of government, the Constitution uses 'Legislative Lists'. Which list details matters that ONLY the Federal Government can legislate upon?
questions.explain: The **Exclusive Legislative List** is a part of the constitution containing matters (such as defense, currency, and foreign affairs) upon which *only* the central (Federal) government can legislate.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education

questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q: Based on constitutional provisions, which of the following items typically falls under the **Exclusive Legislative List**?
options: Printing of National Currency and External Defense
Construction of minor rural community roads
questions.explain: Matters of immense national importance that require absolute uniformity, such as the printing of the **currency (Naira)** and managing the **armed forces (Defense)**, belong exclusively to the Federal Government.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q: What defines the **Concurrent Legislative List** in the Nigerian Constitution?
options: A list of laws that can only be obeyed by state governors
Matters over which both the Federal and State Governments have constitutional powers to legislate
Duties specifically reserved only for Local Government Chairmen
The list of registered political parties cleared to contest in an election
questions.explain: The **Concurrent List** contains matters (such as education, health, and agriculture) where the constitution explicitly grants both the **Federal and State governments** the power to make laws.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q: Any matter that is entirely unmentioned in both the Exclusive and Concurrent Legislative Lists is automatically assigned to the States (and Local governments). What are these unlisted powers called?
questions.explain: Powers over matters that are not specified in the Exclusive or Concurrent lists are known as **Residual Powers**, and these are conventionally left to the jurisdiction of the State governments.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q: Which of the following is a primary point of difference when comparing the **Executive Powers** across the three tiers of government?
options: Only the State tier exercises executive power; the Federal tier does not
At the Federal level, power is held by the President; at the State level by the Governor; and at the Local level by the Chairman
The Local Government has absolute executive power over national foreign policy
The President is democratically elected, while Governors are strictly appointed by the President
questions.explain: The executive structures differ by scale: The **President** wields executive authority for the Federation, the **Governor** for a State, and the **Executive Chairman** for a Local Government Area.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q:
Identify the legislative bodies corresponding to the three tiers of government:

1. National Assembly
2. $W$
3. Local Government Legislative Council

What does $W$ logically represent in this hierarchy?
questions.explain: The law-making (legislative) organs correspond to each tier: The National Assembly (Federal), the **State House of Assembly** (State), and the Legislative Council (Local Government).

questions.q: One major difference among the three tiers of government is their constitutionally assigned functions. Which of the following is an exclusive function of the Local Government?
options: Issuance of international passports to traveling citizens
Creating new currencies and controlling inflation
Registration of births, deaths, and administration of local markets
Declaring war on hostile neighboring countries
questions.explain: According to the Fourth Schedule of the Constitution, functions like managing local markets, motor parks, slaughterhouses, and **registering births and deaths** are the specific responsibilities of the Local Government.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q: In maintaining their constitutional relationship, what is the primary source of revenue legally shared among the Federal, State, and Local governments in Nigeria?
options: Personal donations made by international billionaires
Profits generated strictly from local government market tolls
Fines collected from students who arrive late to school
questions.explain: A critical aspect of inter-governmental relationships in Nigeria is economic; revenue generated nationally is pooled into the **Federation Account** and disbursed among the three tiers based on a constitutional Revenue Allocation Formula.

questions.q: Which tier of government possesses the constitutional power to legally establish, structure, and oversee the existence of Local Government Areas within its geographic jurisdiction?
options: The State Government (via the State House of Assembly)
questions.explain: While Local Governments are recognized as the third tier, they are primarily creations of the **State Governments**. The State House of Assembly is constitutionally empowered to pass laws ensuring their existence, establishment, and structure.

questions.q: Consider a scenario where an outbreak of a strange disease occurs across the nation. Which level(s) of government hold(s) the constitutional power to build hospitals and legislate on general healthcare?
options: Both the Federal and State Governments (Concurrent List)
Neither; healthcare is left exclusively to private foreign companies
questions.explain: Healthcare is a matter found on the **Concurrent Legislative List**, meaning that both Federal and State governments have the power and responsibility to build hospitals and pass health-related laws.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: Relationship Between Federal, State and Local Governments

questions.q: The entire system of distributing powers vertically across the Federal, State, and Local Government is a prime example of which democratic concept?
questions.explain: The sharing of functions and authority from a single central point down to state and local authorities is defined as the **Decentralization of Power**, which is the hallmark of a functioning Federal system.
